dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate with a deep concave spline fitting on the trailing edge from the posterior base to the sub-apex point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate curvature radius at the terminal dorsal point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree convex slope relative to the horizontal dorsal body plane.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible irregular notches and small indentations along the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; distinct white scarring or lesions near the dorsal ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive high-contrast white stippling and speckled pigmentation pattern distributed across the visible dark grey epidermal surface.
